one_line: A one-line promise in the first frame and a top-down album flip as the payoff; cut the 2 minutes between.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a woman sits cross-legged on a bed, low camera angle, talking to the lens, hands on an album and photos. Speech (transcript, poor): she is arranging the family album. Text: "הזיכרון הכי טוב לילדים שלנו זה אלבום תמונות".
q1_hook.why: A face and a voice from 0:00 (H4), with a clear statement of value written on screen (H2, T3), about a feeling parents of babies share (K6). But the claim is a general opinion, not a surprising question or result (against H5), and the album is only at the bottom edge of the frame (H1).

beats.what: She talks to the lens; headline text and a heart
She shows loose printed photos and says she is arranging the family album
beats.why: Sets up the habit, with little to look at yet

beats.what: A large brown album with a gold title; she flips pages of newborn photos in sleeves
beats.why: The first look at the product, though held at an angle

beats.what: A baby is on her lap; she keeps talking and gestures
beats.why: A small change of picture, but the talk is the same

beats.what: She holds up a card with writing on it and one printed photo
beats.why: The date-and-story note is a copyable tip

beats.what: She talks to the lens with the baby on her lap, gesturing
beats.why: Half a minute with no new picture

beats.what: She holds up a stack of printed photos and one in close-up
beats.why: Shows what goes into the album

beats.what: She plays with the baby, lifts him, then waves
beats.why: Wrap-up with a kiss to the lens at 2:11

beats.what: Top-down on a play mat: she turns album spreads from newborn to older baby; a pink text box
beats.why: The strongest part, and the only text after 0:03

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: none. The caption has no question or ask; a parent might send the idea to another new mother.
q2_flow.why: The payoff, a filled album of nine months of photos, arrives at 2:11 and is the best moment, closing the opening promise (R4, K2). The 131 s before it is one uncut talking take with few new pictures (R1, R3). At 159 s it is far longer than its single idea needs, close to the 3-minute ceiling (R2).

q3_cta.what: None. No ask on screen or in the caption. The caption opens: "לעוד עשרות אלבומים כאלה עם הרגעים הכי טובים שלנו ושלהם בחיים"; the last on-screen text says she will keep collecting dozens of albums.
q3_cta.why: Nothing asks the viewer to comment, send or save, though a habit tip like this could earn a send (C4, R5), and no product link or name is given. It ends on a feeling, not an action, so a viewer who wants an album has no next step.

q4_shown.what: The creator's face 0:00-2:10; loose photos 0:09-0:16; a brown album with a gold title 0:17-0:45; a baby on her lap from 0:47; a handwritten note 0:59-1:05; photos in her hand 1:39-1:57; a top-down flip of filled spreads 2:11-2:38. No price.
q4_shown.why: A first-person habit told by a mother, with a real filled album as proof (S6, K2). The result, nine months of photos, is shown only after 2 minutes (R4). It does not show the printing or ordering (S8), and a baby's face is on screen for most of the Reel (S5).

q5_edit.what: 2 shots in 159 s: one uncut talking take of about 131 s, then a 26 s top-down take. No other cuts or speed changes. Text only at 0:00-0:03 and in the last take. Speech throughout the first take, no subtitles. It ends mid-flip.
q5_edit.why: One take with no cuts has no new picture for long stretches (against E2, R3). Speech with no subtitles means a muted viewer gets only a headline (against T1, E4). The top-down end take is a clean 26 s, though it has no closing frame (E8).

q6_topic.what: How a mother keeps a printed family album, adding dated photos every two months; it serves new parents who want to keep their children's moments.
q6_topic.why: A real feeling, keeping a baby's first months, with a practical habit (K6, K4), which a parent could send to a friend with a new baby (R5). The mood is warm and tired with no high peak (K1), and it overlaps with what LumeBook sells.

q7_filmed.what: A static low-angle phone on a bed, a shutter behind; one adult talks to the lens, later with a baby on her lap; hands hold up the album, photos and a note; last take: handheld top-down album on a play mat. Indoor light.
q7_filmed.why: A face talking to the lens at home feels personal (F6, H8), but the low angle and dim room make it look unplanned (F7). Held-up photos are small and often blurred (F4). The top-down album take is the clearest view of the product (F5, S4).

q8_text.on_screen: 0:00-0:03 white text on a plain dark band, two lines and a pink heart, about 55 to 65 percent down, over her hands: "הזיכרון הכי טוב לילדים שלנו זה אלבום תמונות". From 2:13 to the end a pink box, three lines: "כמעט 9 חודשים של הרגעים הכי טובים", "נמצאים באלבום לכל החיים", "שנמשיך לצבור עשרות אלבומים כאלה". No subtitles of speech.
q8_text.caption: "לעוד עשרות אלבומים כאלה עם הרגעים הכי טובים שלנו ושלהם בחיים", then a second sentence and rows of emojis. About 31 words, no ask, 5 hashtags (#אמהות #תינוקות #תאומים #ילדים #תינוק). No disclosure.
q8_text.why: The first line is a clear promise (T3) and the end box repeats the feeling, but the text sits low and is gone in 3 s, and 2 minutes of speech has no captions (T4, T1). The caption starts mid-thought, not with the product or occasion in search words (T7).

weak_points: 159 s, mostly one uncut take with a low angle; no subtitles; the payoff after 2 minutes; no ask or product link; a baby's face for most of the Reel; the end text small.
lumebook_takeaway: Film the 20 s top-down page flip with a short text line over it. Leave out the long talking take.
not_verified: Speech after about 1:30 (the transcript covers the first 90 s only and is poor, so no lines are quoted); music; whether she sells or links anything; where the album was bought. Corrections: contact sheets are about 2 s apart; the headline runs about 0-3 s; the top-down take starts at about 2:11; a baby sits on her lap from about 0:47. The twins reference comes only from a hashtag.
